cohort: Isolated Dev runtime-artifact maintenance rollback from leased candidate001 to unleased legacy003.
analysisScope: Read-only analysis of recovered local evidence; no host, task, ticket, marker or lease mutation by this analyzer.

serving.qualification: Installed metadata, manifests, marker declarations and selected script hashes were observed; ZIP declarations do not attest every loaded file.

collection.qualification: All retained bytes were recollected on the subsequent boot and digest verified. No finished record exists; two-second polling writes only changed fingerprints.

ownership.qualification: The target003 launcher has no lease helper. Its intentionally unclaimed validation reservation retains the source owner and physical root; this is not a completed target lease or a readiness claim.

sourceRetention.qualification: Source folder retention is observed in changed-pointer snapshots. Exact source termination falls between the last-presence and first-absence samples; first absence is after provider stopping began. The change-only observer does not prove continuous absence or every possible write.

legacyTarget.validationArgumentQualification: The observer raw-line mode regex recorded false for the target CMD; this does not independently establish the actual quoted flag. Validation mode is established by the handoff reservation and successful maintenance validation outcome.

ancestryProof.qualification: Shipping ancestry belongs to the target validation CMD through its native gate and outer executable, with source updater and source owner co-captured. Parent PID and birth ordering are observational ancestry; not retained-handle continuous identity proof.

legacyTarget.qualification: Legacy003 started a cleanup recovery launcher and a second Node while the validation-owned Shipping process persisted. This route differs from the leased candidate replacement contract.

legacyRecoveryState.qualification: Legacy marker and commercial latch observations show cleanup/recovery progression. They do not attest candidate helper/source birth binding, an API ACK or stale-ticket rejection.

validation.qualification: Fresh runtime Ready followed by validated_runtime_artifact success matches the requested target and exact saved job across provider snapshots. The later UI marks retained runtime tags stale. No interactive media or full native-heap compatibility check was performed in this maintenance leg.

providerStop.qualification: Provider state is independently observed as stopped after this fresh maintenance boot. Persisted Ready tags on a stopped instance are historical validation evidence, not current liveness.

sourceCaller.qualification: Candidate001 intentionally handles maintenance terminal codes before a retargeted CALL. This source journal ends at update_control.started; absence of a terminal End is not proof of a particular CMD exit code or continuous no-continuation.

disposition: Scoped Dev001-to-legacy003 rollback passed fresh runtime maintenance validation and actual provider stop, with observed source retention, exact reserved-entry/source-owner pins and qualified native ancestry. Full return compatibility is pending the separate legacy003-to-candidate001 leg.
limitations: Two-second change-only process and pointer snapshots cannot prove continuous actor exclusion or rule out every transient duplicate, PID reuse or source-folder gap.
Source owner/updater were first observed absent after provider stopping began; their exact termination cause/time and exit-before-stop are not proved.
The target CMD mode parser recorded false; the persisted validation reservation and successful validation outcome establish intent/result, without independent raw argv attestation.
Legacy003 produced two Node births while one validation-owned Shipping identity persisted. No fresh full-native replacement or native heap cleanliness is claimed.
Source retention and final actor absence are sampled observations, not retained-handle cancellation proof.
Full retained journal bytes are verified, but the planned observer was interrupted and has no finished record.

Fresh Ready and successful maintenance tags establish runtime validation outcome; they do not prove usable interactive media, every source continuation/write path, token admission semantics or all compatibility.
The legacy003-to-candidate001 return and subsequent ordinary cold start remain separate acceptance gates.
No Stage, Prod, fleet-wide or all failure-window safety claim follows from this isolated Dev rollback.
